Today Morgan Stanley Keeps a “Equal-Weight” Rating on MINDBODY (NASDAQ:MB) and a $40 Target Price
August 1, 2018 - By Gary Bell MINDBODY (NASDAQ:MB) Rating Reaffirmed
Recently, In analysts report published on Wednesday, 1 August, MINDBODY (NASDAQ:MB) shares have had their “Equal-Weight” Rating reconfirmed by research professionals at Morgan Stanley, who currently has a $40 target price on company. This target by Morgan Stanley indicates the possibile upside of 14.29 % from the previous close. MINDBODY, Inc. (NASDAQ:MB) Ratings Coverage
Among 8 analysts covering MINDBODY ( NASDAQ:MB ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. MINDBODY has $47 highest and $36 lowest target. $41.50’s average target is 18.57% above currents $35 stock price. MINDBODY had 13 analyst reports since February 14, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Imperial Capital maintained it with “Outperform” rating and $42 target in Friday, February 23 report. The company was maintained on Thursday, March 15 by Roth Capital. Craig Hallum maintained MINDBODY, Inc. (NASDAQ:MB) rating on Thursday, February 22. Craig Hallum has “Buy” rating and $40.0 target. Craig Hallum downgraded MINDBODY, Inc. (NASDAQ:MB) on Wednesday, May 9 to “Hold” rating. The company was maintained on Thursday, February 22 by Credit Suisse. The stock of MINDBODY, Inc. (NASDAQ:MB) has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, March 13 by Craig Hallum. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Equal-Weight” rating and $42 target in Wednesday, May 9 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by Roth Capital on Wednesday, February 14. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, March 13 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. Jefferies maintained MINDBODY, Inc. (NASDAQ:MB) rating on Monday, April 16. Jefferies has “Buy” rating and $4500 target.
The stock decreased 6.29% or $2.35 during the last trading session, reaching $35. About 2.90 million shares traded or 335.06% up from the average. MINDBODY, Inc. (NASDAQ:MB) has risen 35.54% since August 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 22.97% the S&P500.
MINDBODY, Inc. operates a cloud-based business management software and payments platform for the small and medium-sized businesses in the wellness services industry. The company has market cap of $1.66 billion. The Company’s platform enables businesses to run, market, and build client scheduling and online booking, staff management, client relationship management, integrated payment processing, retail point-of-sale, analytics and reporting, simple and intuitive user experience, mobility, branded Web, social integration, cloud architecture, open platform for third-party application development, security and compliance, and integration with other cloud partners for yoga, Pilates, barre, indoor cycling, personal training, martial arts, and dance exercise, spas, salons, music instruction studios, dance studios, childrenÂ’s activity centers, and integrative health centers. It currently has negative earnings. The firm offers its software platform to its subscribers as a subscription service.
